snippets.snippet_text: "In January 2025 I contacted Domestika to cancel my subscription and request a refund for an unexpected charge of €125.46. They never responded. Not once. Based on their silence, I assumed the subscription was cancelled. In January 2026 they charged me again — this time $347.52 — with no prior renewal notification whatsoever. I have now sent 7+ emails over 13 months. Zero responses."
